title: GIVL: Improving Geographical Inclusivity of Vision-Language Models with Pre-Training Methods
benchmark_measurement: The model's ability to perform visual commonsense reasoning on images depicting religious and cultural scenarios from diverse, particularly non-Western, geographical regions. This was evaluated as part of a broader assessment of geographical inclusivity.
findings: The proposed model, GIVL, demonstrates improved performance and a reduced performance gap between Western and non-Western scenarios on tasks involving geo-diverse concepts, which include religious contexts. Specifically, in a qualitative study on the GD-VCR dataset, GIVL showed a smaller performance disparity and higher accuracy on non-Western images in the 'Religion' category compared to the VinVL baseline model.
